name: iphone-use
description: iPhone Use: let your agent operate a real iPhone through the iphone-use daemon on your Mac.

plugins.name: iphone-use
plugins.description: Drive a real iPhone from your agent: read the screen as text, tap, type, scroll and replay saved per-app flows through the iphone-use daemon on your Mac. The daemon is installed separately with install.sh.

args: mcp="$HOME/Applications/iPhoneUse.app/Contents/MacOS/iphone-use-mcp"; [ -x "$mcp" ] || { echo 'iphone-use is not installed on this Mac. Install it with: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leeguooooo/iphone-use/main/install.sh | sh' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$mcp"
